Day Trips from Seville — Ronda, Córdoba & Caminito del Rey

Seville is the perfect base for a day out: reach Ronda's clifftop bridge, the Mezquita of Córdoba or the vertigo-inducing Caminito del Rey walkway in a couple of hours, then be back by evening. These day trips bundle transport, entry and a guide into one booking, so compare options and prices below.

Good to know
How do I book tickets?

Tap ‘Book’ on any experience — you'll go to our official partner (such as Fever) to reserve and pay on their secure site. Seville Tours & More is a free guide.

Are the prices up to date?

Prices come from live availability and show the lowest ‘from’ ticket. Always confirm the exact date, time and price at checkout before paying.

Do I need to book in advance?

For popular day trips — Caminito del Rey, Córdoba and Ronda especially — booking ahead is recommended, as they sell out in high season.
